name: Procyclidine
summary: Procyclidine is an anticholinergic drug principally used for the treatment of drug-induced parkinsonism, akathisia and acute dystonia, Parkinson's disease, and idiopathic or secondary dystonia.

pharmacology.text: Procyclidine is an anticholinergic. It is specifically an antimuscarinic. The drug acts as a non-selective antagonist of the muscarinic acetylcholine M1, M2, and M4 receptors, whereas its activities at the M3 and M5 receptors are reportedly unknown.

uses.text: It is used in patients with parkinsonism and akathisia, and to reduce the side effects of antipsychotic treatment given for schizophrenia. Procyclidine is also a second-line drug for the treatment of Parkinson's disease. It improves tremor but not rigidity or bradykinesia.

sideEffects.text: Side effects include nausea, constipation, urinary retention, blurred vision, anxiety, cognitive impairment, confusion, dizziness, gingivitis, hallucination, memory loss, rash and vomiting.

summaryZh: 丙環定（英語：Procyclidine）是一種含氮有機化合物，分子式C19H29NO，通常以鹽酸鹽的形式存在，可作為抗膽鹼劑。

fact.en: Procyclidine was introduced in the 1950s under the name Kemadrin, as one of a group of anticholinergic drugs used for Parkinson's disease before levodopa arrived.
fact.zh: 丙環定於 1950 年代以 Kemadrin 之名上市，是左旋多巴問世前用來治療帕金森氏症的抗膽鹼藥物之一。
fact.zhHans: 丙环定于 1950 年代以 Kemadrin 之名上市，是左旋多巴问世前用来治疗帕金森氏症的抗胆碱药物之一。
